messages:
Priya Nair (CSM): FYI — NovaCore just flipped governance contact and their API keys show 0 activity since 2024-06-12. Usage yesterday was 65k tokens, today 0. Renewal in 10w. @Mike Chen can you ping procurement contact?
Mike Chen (AE): on it. do we have any alerts from the onboarding flow or billing?
Priya Nair (CSM): No billing alerts. I checked Console -> per-route usage: all routes show 0 requests after 06/12 03:14 UTC. No errors in their logs.
Jon Alvarez (Solutions): could be a prod key rotation or proxy change on their side. can we confirm if requests are hitting our edge? Sam, can you run a quick edge log query?
Sam Rivera (Support): running query now: `edge.requests.filter(org_id=="nova_core").between(1745410000,1745551200).group_by(status)`
Sam Rivera (Support): quick dump: 06/12 02:00–03:20 = 0 requests; last seen request 06/12 03:14 -> 200 OK. nothing after.
Priya Nair (CSM): I just emailed their new head of governance (cc'd procurement). Reply said "we're migrating traffic to internal gateway this week". no mention of Redwood.
Mike Chen (AE): classic procurement-led migration. Are they evaluating a competitor gateway or self-hosting?
Priya Nair (CSM): Not explicit. Their note: "central infra consolidation; may re-route LLM calls via service mesh". sounds like internal infra change not explicit vendor swap.
Jon Alvarez (Solutions): Ok — two risk vectors: 1) migration breaks our integration (accidental zero traffic) 2) active evaluation vs competitor. We should treat as renewal risk until confirmed.
Priya Nair (CSM): Agreed. Quick plan: A) Confirm whether calls are intentionally routed off Redwood B) Ask for a short health-check call with their infra lead C) Prepare a 30-minute "keep-me-online" ops playbook and offer a quick remediation window.
Mike Chen (AE): I'll ask procurement for contact and ask whether a POC with another vendor is happening. Priya, can you offer the ops playbook & a 1hr emergency runbook?
Priya Nair (CSM): I'll draft playbook now. Key points: check API host rewrite, update K/V cache expectations, ensure API key present in mesh, fallback to regional endpoint if mesh strips headers. Also include `curl` test snippet: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"input":"hi"}'`
Sam Rivera (Support): I'll prepare edge traces and a short packet-level checklist to share on the call.
redwood-bot: Reminder — create incident INVEST-2024-078 and link to account nova_core for tracking.
Priya Nair (CSM): Created INVEST-2024-078. Scheduled a sync with NovaCore infra for tomorrow 09:00 PT. Invite sent to procurement + infra + product.
Mike Chen (AE): Good. Also request: ask if they're running any rate-limiting at the mesh that could be dropping outbound requests to external APIs. common gotcha.
Jon Alvarez (Solutions): Prep a short side-by-side: current route -> `api.redwood.ai` vs mesh rewrite -> `internal-llm.svc.cluster.local` and common header stripping symptoms. I'll assemble a 1-pager.
Priya Nair (CSM): If they confirm competitive pilot, escalate to AM and Sales leadership. For now we treat as high-priority renewal watch.
Sam Rivera (Support): After traces, found 3 dropped requests from 06/12 04:02–04:05 with `403` originating from their proxy IPs — looks like outbound firewall rules changed. Sharing snippet in thread.
Priya Nair (CSM): Thanks Sam. I'll push that to them with a short ask: "Can infra whitelist our egress and run the curl test above?"
Mike Chen (AE): Copy. If they push back, offer a short dedicated capacity window (no extra cost) to keep them running during migration — gesture to preserve renewal.
Priya Nair (CSM): Noted. Ops playbook + traces + 1-pager assembled. Next check-in after the 09:00 sync. Thanks team :pray:
